profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Node.js, React, PostgreSQL
profile.summary: Strategic Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years of end-to-end ownership building and modernizing large-scale SaaS platforms. Excel at designing scalable backend and frontend systems, optimizing complex data pipelines, and translating business requirements into clean technical solutions. Proven technical leader and mentor who drives quality, iteration speed, and user-focused delivery while collaborating cross-functionally in Agile environments. Proficiency across Node, PHP, TypeScript, React, distributed systems, and AWS, with hands-on building AI-assisted workflows and AI-powered product features, and a track record of ramping quickly on new stacks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered AI-workflow features that increased revenue-driving activity such as Job Autofill, reducing manual posting from 15 minutes to 1 minute. Built company-wide OpenAI extraction microservices and optimized the scrape/parse/fill pipeline from 2+ minutes to 2-3 seconds.
• Worked with Data Scientist to implement a hybrid search system for NLS by combining vector and lexical search, enabling users to query for talent using semantic intent, which improved search accuracy by 25% and increased successful candidate matches by 20%.
• Architected distributed worker systems with RabbitMQ that process thousands of jobs daily at 99% uptime, powering recommended candidate generation, automated emails, and time-sensitive workflows.
• Designed foundational, future-proof infrastructure - Built internationalization framework supporting multiple regions with configurable features and data models, enabling scalable expansion with minimal rework.
• Translated complex technical and business requirements into simple, clean solutions - Designed delayed-task processing with RabbitMQ’s DLX to power reliable scheduling and cancellation for the Autoresponders system.
• Anticipated business needs and mitigated risks proactively - Independently implemented Sendgrid Webhook for real-time email data capture and provided critical technical/UX input in product meetings to prevent costly rework.
• Served as de facto technical lead and primary escalation point - Owned end-to-end resolution of complex customer issues across backend, frontend, and infrastructure while coordinating cross-functional teams.
• Mentored and raised team capability - Onboarded and mentored junior developers through documentation, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing on code quality and query optimization.
• Strengthened engineering excellence and delivery reliability - Modernized CI/CD pipeline with automated analysis and test gates; pioneered AI-assisted test generation to restore pipelines and reduce manual effort.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Took a major role, in both backend and frontend, in the developing OneStop app that led to a successful product release, after which product's average daily revenue was increased to $16K (from $9K in the previous version).
•	Worked in team with 2 other back-end and 1 front-end members to built the new version 2.0 in a completely new architecture with PHP on the back-end and AngularJS on the front-end.
•	Developed technical solutions that improve product's responsiveness, scalability, and performance by utilizing OOD and implementing optimized database solutions, in a rapid application development environment.
•	Managed time-critical customer escalations and provided satisfactory resolution.
•	Collaborated with mobile teams to implement API tasks for Android and iOS OneStop apps.
•	Rewarded as one of the MVP's of Q2 2014.
      Tools: PHP, AngularJS/Javascript/AJAX, MySQL, JSON, E2E Test with Protractor, MVC, SVN, Git

positions.title: System Analyst and Developer
positions.description:
•	Self-learned totally new tools/technologies in the job and used them to finished a half-way done web app within the first 3 months to maximize the workflow of the Issue Center in issuing sports equipment 
•	Increased productivity for Fitness Center, Reading and Writing Center by building web applications that are used on a daily basis among 2500 students and 500 employees.
•	Experienced in all software development lifecycle procedures from conception to completion to maintenance
Tools: Java, Spring, Hibernate, JUnit, MVC, JSP, Apache Tomcat, JQuery, AJAX, XML, JSON, MySQL, Oracle

positions.title: Computer Lab Tutor - Lead
positions.description:
•	Got hired after taking only first two programming classes due to ability to learn quickly
•	Obtained excellent debugging skills through quickly locating and fixing bugs for students' projects/assignments
•	Gained a great deal of communication, reasoning, problem solving skills from everyday's face-to face tutoring
•	Led a team of 8 tutors: arranged schedule, assigned work, and made sure everyone was doing their job
Tools: Java, Eclipse, Android, Swing, C#, C++, Ruby on Rails, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Perl
